evidence_policy: Each platform and metric is labeled by evidence basis. Dated owner exports, public verification, external indexes, owner reports and canonical links are not presented as equivalent. Unsupported live counts are omitted.
privacy_policy: Raw private platform exports, private messages, children, unpublished Drive or Notion URLs and personal correspondence remain excluded. Only safe account-level snapshots and public-source links are published.
route_policy: Critical public routes have unique titles, descriptions, canonicals and crawlable content. No critical route uses meta-refresh.
qa_policy: Acceptance requires a terminal ready deployment, no frontend/backend/network errors, synchronized release markers, crawlable critical routes, responsive desktop/mobile evidence and all defined E2E jobs passing.

qa_contract.required_backend_endpoint_coverage: release-critical live /api/health exercised; full backend API coverage is not a visual-release gate
qa_contract.required_safe_diagnostics: /integrity/ PASS · 8/8 critical routes · 4/4 release surfaces · 0 private URL leaks
qa_contract.acceptance: Terminal AppDeploy QA for the applied immutable snapshot is authoritative.
